senses.gloss: (b. h.), Pi. אִיהֵל (deriv. of אֹהֶל) to spread tent-like, to cover, shade, bend over &c., usu. with refer. to levitical uncleanness arising from being under the same shelter with, or forming a shelter over, a corpse &c. Meïlah 17ᵃ אי׳ על מקצתו if he bent over a portion (of the blood).
units: Sabb. 17ᵃ אי׳ צדו אחת וכ׳ he caused one side of his body to overshadow the grave.—[More freq.]

senses.gloss: <cite ref="A00499">same</cite>. Ohol. III, 1; 3 sq. <he>הא׳ על המת</he> he formed a tent, i.e. spread himself, or bent, over a corpse. Ib. <he>הבית מַאֲחִיל עליו</he> the house forms a cover over part of it. Y. Sot. IX, 23ᶜ top; a. fr.
